title: Profiles: Move all UI functionality to the model
description:
Move remaining profile functionality out of UI layer and into the model.  Only have the model read in the settings file when needed (auto switch filter for profile switcher)

Also, use ProfileModel for ProfileSwitcher

AI-Assisted: no

changed the description

Took a different direction than the original.  Now, instead of using the epan preference API for profiles, the handling of settings is done in the (Profile) model, following the WorkspaceState handling of preferences.
Some questions:
1. @rknall - How does this look "architecturally"?  Should there be more "shared code" with parsing the profile preference file (when effectively treating it as an INI file)
2. Do we still want a standalone preferences files for profiles?  I lean "yes", but it only has a single preference (there is #10352, suggesting it could be expanded, and that's part of the reason for this initial refactor). Should this be rolled into the recent file (that's a part of each profile)?
3. Do we want the profile preference file to have "translated" comments?  Since it's now at the Qt layer, that's possible (and currently being done in the MR).  And as long as the line is prefixed by a '#', it doesn't really care what the text is.
Was able to pull all functionality into profile model (and I need to still do more testing on my end), but how are we feeling about the architecture questions above?
